death_rebirth_test.purpose: Prove that Hermes continuity works across session death/rebirth, profile switch, and engine swap

test_scenarios.description: Close session A -> handoff -> dream-review -> session B (same profile) -> verify continuity
steps: SESSION_A: Execute mission -> emit handoff receipt -> save LAST_GOOD_STATE
SESSION_B: Boot with same profile -> verify LAST_GOOD_STATE fingerprint match
VERIFY: Governance loaded, skills loaded, LAST_GOOD_STATE available, intent continued
REPRODUCE: Scenario from SESSION_A error -> verify corrected behavior
pass_criteria: Error from SESSION_A does not repeat

test_scenarios.description: Switch profile mid-mission -> verify state preserved
steps: VERIFY: Governance + LAST_GOOD_STATE + skills + intent preserved
VERIFY: Same governance, skills, state, intent
pass_criteria: Same LAST_GOOD_STATE, same governance, same skills
